metadata.description: Skill-building utilities by Yoda — meta-skills, decomposition tools, and critical-thinking helpers.

plugins.name: skill-architect
plugins.description: Critical-thinking decomposition skill that runs before any new skill is authored. v0.3 adopts the Olympus SDLC inheritance pattern: Inherits-From headers, folder-and-file nesting, READ-FIRST preamble in every authored SKILL.md.

plugins.name: project-wiki
plugins.description: Karpathy-style LLM Wiki applied across every Claude Code and Cowork project. Canonical layout (raw/ + output/ + wiki/ + code/wiki/), Obsidian-compatible vault, clean takeover of existing project conventions, snapshot of outer wiki into code/wiki on /go-to-code. Three policies baked in: default-to-output, curate-to-wiki (mandatory wiki-curator gate), and keep-it-lean (wiki-pruner compacts verbose investigation pages once issues resolve; archived detail goes to output/). Fifteen layered skills inheriting from skill-architect's foundation abstracts.

plugins.name: session-bridge
plugins.description: Query other Claude Code sessions on this machine as if they were tools (RAG-like read sources). Ships a custom subagent type (`session-bridge:session-querier`), two slash commands (`/sb-list`, `/sb-poll`), and a using-session-bridge skill that enforces a strict privacy contract: target sessions are read sources, only the querier touches them, the umbrella session never absorbs transcripts. Default mode is branch-and-query (the target's JSONL is copied, queried via headless `claude --resume`, then the copy is deleted). Append mode is opt-in and refuses to write to sessions with in-flight work. No MCP server; auto-discovers sessions in ~/.claude/projects/ with a 7-day recency filter, .trash/ excluded.
